headline: Moss Hires Senior SDK Engineer for AI Products Moss seeks expert for real-time AI SDKs
summary: Moss is hiring a Senior SDK Engineer to optimize and maintain its real-time semantic search layer for conversational AI across multiple platforms.
details: Moss, a YC-backed startup, is looking for a Senior or Staff SDK Engineer to own the shipping of its SDKs across every developer surface, including JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Swift, Android, Elixir, C, and the Rust core.

The engineer will work on live SDKs that customers depend on in production, focusing on shrinking bundle size, lowering cold-start and query latency, tightening cross-platform parity, and improving developer ergonomics.

Moss's real-time semantic search layer delivers sub-10ms retrieval directly in the browser, at the edge, on-device, or in the cloud, and is deployed across 100+ countries, serving 5M+ of real-time voice minutes and supporting enterprises with 3000+ end customers.
caption:
Can a Senior SDK Engineer boost AI product trust with sub-10ms retrieval?

Moss, a YC-backed startup, is looking for a Senior or Staff SDK Engineer to own the shipping of its SDKs across every developer surface, including JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Swift, Android, Elixir, C, and the Rust core.

The engineer will work on live SDKs that customers depend on in production, focusing on shrinking bundle size, lowering cold-start and query latency, tightening cross-platform parity, and improving developer ergonomics.

Moss's real-time semantic search layer delivers sub-10ms retrieval directly in the browser, at the edge, on-device, or in the cloud, and is deployed across 100+ countries, serving 5M+ of real-time voice minutes and supporting enterprises with 3000+ end customers.
